overlap_check.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse. Historical query, question, original_query and forms are extracted recursively from the listed *cases*.json files and b17-policy.json; no corpus or predictions are read.
overlap_check.manual_subject_operation_check: All 24 operation relations are new. Previously tested broad language/platform families are retained intentionally; HashMap Entry differs from ConcurrentHashMap.computeIfAbsent, context.WithoutCancel differs from asyncio cancellation, SQLite BETWEEN differs from NOT IN/NOT EXISTS, and the reference-overload return/identity relation for Interlocked.CompareExchange differs from Rust compare_exchange failure ordering. None repeats rstrip/removesuffix, Object.freeze, dup/dup2, or Redis EXPIRE.

comparison_protocol: Freeze this cases file and plan before retrieval capture, source acquisition or new model inference. Never replace, reword or discard a query after observing availability or outcomes.

Capture Seznam/Naver HTML through the existing guarded Rust source path after checking the latest source-block reports. Retain source errors; no blocked-source retries, CAPTCHA bypass, proxy/fingerprint changes, seeded official URLs, third-party search/scraping APIs or new providers.

Only URLs present in the frozen retrieved candidate cards are eligible for raw pre-acquisition. Pre-acquire all unique retrieved candidate URLs in a deterministic case-ID/candidate-rank order into one guarded immutable raw URL cache, retaining failures and inherited blocked-host outcomes. This is preparation overhead and must be reported separately from each branch four-read budget. Never add source-gold URLs to retrieval.

Freeze the raw-cache manifest and content/failure hashes before authoring final gold. Both branches must read identical cached bytes and errors, with no live acquisition or uncached-URL fallback during inference. Candidate/read admission remains each branch own runtime decision; neither gold nor source labels may influence it.

The source-only author reads complete normalized original source snapshots, scans all relevant operation/qualifier concepts including late sections and alternatives, and records exact UTF-8 quote offsets/hashes. Do not annotate from branch extraction, selected windows, model calls, predictions or runtime labels.

Gold grades: 2=complete source-bound requested relation/material conditions, 1=partial or wrong-operation/product near-miss, 0=unrelated or source-explicit contrary scoped behavior, null=unobserved/acquisition failure. A factual source that refutes a query false premise can be grade2. Do not infer correctness from host, document genre, navigation or title alone.

A separate reviewer reads the source-only drafts and complete retained documents; resolve disagreements against original bytes before final gold freeze. Save author, peer-review, cache-completeness and input/code freeze evidence before any new model inference. Do not present peer source review as independent product acceptance.

Freeze baseline and fixed executable/configuration hashes, cases/retrieval/source-cache/gold/peer hashes and shared trusted startup settings before inference. Use the existing pinned DeepSeek and local Qwen without new dependencies/models or key changes. Keep 3 generative calls, 4 reads, 4 local Qwen calls, 180 seconds and 24k source context per query.

Run paired baseline/fixed full pipelines on all 24 frozen cases with the same candidate pools and raw cache. Keep old four-miss development cases and known false-direct controls separate; do not inspect holdout predictions until both runs finish.

Compute source-level direct recall, false direct counts/IDs, unknown directs, candidate/read/top10 recall, stage losses, budgets, costs and query-cluster uncertainty. Source-level denominators and unavailable sources stay explicit. No post-prediction relabeling; report any source-gold error through a separately preserved erratum and sensitivity only.

Publish measured results and concrete limits in doc. Accept the candidate only with a recall gain and no new known false-direct IDs on this cohort and retained controls; otherwise disclose the failed tradeoff rather than tuning this holdout.
limitations: The cohort is selected using known failure classes and planned admission/literal scope, without viewing new sources or predictions; it is an exploratory engineering sample, not an independent general benchmark.
Twenty-four queries do not guarantee known positives per query; source blocks, document type/language and unknown labels must be retained in denominators and limitations.
Pre-acquiring every retrieved candidate has extra preparation network/cost/time overhead and does not establish a production global budget.
Source-only peer review is separate from formal independent implementation acceptance.
This plan does not authorize another external provider, browser bypass, VPS or global configuration changes.
